ticker_news.title: Why Amazon, Meta Platforms, and Alphabet Slumped on Wednesday
ticker_news.description: The U.S. economy contracted in the first quarter of 2025, raising fears of a potential recession. This news has negatively impacted tech giants like Amazon, Meta Platforms, and Alphabet, as they are major providers of digital advertising, which is typically one of the first budget items cut during economic downturns.
ticker_news.author: The Motley Fool

ticker_news.title: Amazon Earnings Will Make or Break the Stock's Comeback
ticker_news.description: Amazon's upcoming earnings report is crucial for the stock's recovery, with analysts largely bullish on the company's long-term prospects despite near-term challenges.
ticker_news.author: Marketbeat.Com
